title: the-proveme-door-refuses-a-proof-name-that-resolves-to-no-file
intention: The forward crossing into PROVEME refuses when any proof it would carry to PROVED — named on this crossing or on one since the latest forward BUILDME — resolves to no file, so a dead proven_by is caught at the crossing where naming the right path is still free instead of at the hollow or at PROVED.
why: Measured 2026-10-07 on 41202d4c8d3b (8y): its PROVEME crossing (skills/sail/history.json, 19:53:47) named proven_by 'test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py', a bare name resolving to no file, and the proof-named seat recorded 'clean — proof named'. The hollow then refused ('none of the proofs [...] declares a PROVES entry'), and the only repair was a kick-back to TICKETME, because proven_by_since_buildme cuts only at a forward BUILDME and clearance's [proof_on_disk] would red the dead name at PROVED. Peer F19 (2026-10-08): 'Finding 1: YES, ticket it. The PROVEME door refuses a proven_by that resolves to no file, which is the same vacuous shape as F16.'
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass — a name that points at nothing is a vacuous pass of the seat, the same shape F16 refused) and Law 7 (errors are loud at the diagnostic surface: the seat said 'clean — proof named' over a name that named nothing).
how: Extend the proof-named seat in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py (inspect_proof_named, ticket 7203db7f151e) with a second lane: each name in the union is resolved the way proof_coverage.lacks resolves it at PROVED (absolute as is, else the cairn repo root / name) and must be a file; ProofNamedRed carries the dead names and where each came from. New proof in cairn/tools/base/proofs.
falsifier: Falsifier: a new proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_dead_proof_name_is_refused_at_proveme.py, green and sealed under bin/cairn test --netns, teeth under PROVES for this ticket: (1) test_a_bare_name_that_resolves_to_no_file_is_refused — a fixture PROVEME crossing with proven_by = this proof's bare filename (it exists in proofs/, not at the repo root: the 8y shape exactly) raises ProofNamedRed naming the name, the lane finding has expected != actual and values.dead == [{name, from: 'this crossing'}], and no history or state is written; (2) test_a_real_path_crosses_and_a_mixed_list_names_only_the_dead — the repo-relative path of this proof crosses with the lane reading clean and values.dead == []; its absolute path crosses too; a list [real path, 'p/gone.py'] is refused naming only 'p/gone.py'; (3) test_a_dead_name_since_buildme_is_refused — with crossings.ROOTS pointed at a fixture world whose history.json holds a forward BUILDME crossing for the fixture ticket carrying proven_by 'p/gone.py', a PROVEME crossing naming a real proof is refused naming 'p/gone.py' from 'since BUILDME'. test_proveme_names_its_proof.py, test_transitions.py and harbor_master's test_clearance.py stay green unchanged. Hollow: teeth 1-3 red with transitions.py reverted to the pre-build commit (each depends on a refusal the old seat never makes). Horizon: this voyage; then every ticketed PROVEME record carries values.dead.
watchme: none, because the live reading is the next ticketed PROVEME crossing: the proof-named seat in /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/base/transitions.py writes its lane, now carrying values.dead, onto that crossing's record in the component's history.json, so a dead name is either refused or visibly absent
children: none, because one helper and one lane's actual text in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py, one message branch in _proof_named_gate, and one new proof file
builder_notes: Questions a Haiku-level builder would need, answered: WHERE? cairn/tools/base/transitions.py only, plus the new proof. (A) New helper _dead_names(ticket: str, named: list[str], since: list[str]) -> list[dict] directly above inspect_proof_named: for each name in named then since (deduped, first origin wins: named -> 'this crossing', since -> 'since BUILDME'), p = Path(name) if Path(name).is_absolute() else _REPO_ROOT / name; if not p.is_file(): append {'name': name, 'from': origin}. (B) In inspect_proof_named, after union: dead = _dead_names(ticket, named, list(since)); actual = shown if union and not dead; if not union: the existing no-proof text; if dead: f"the PROVEME crossing of ticket {ticket!r} names {len(dead)} proof(s) that resolve to no file: " + '; '.join(f"{d['name']!r} ({d['from']})" for d in dead) + " — a name is read repo-relative under the cairn root or absolute, as proof_coverage reads it at PROVED, which would refuse it as [proof_on_disk]"; pass dead=dead into _lane values beside named and since_buildme. The lane identity the_proveme_crossing_names_its_proof, expected, and code string stay; still ONE lane. (C) _proof_named_gate: when the mismatch is a dead name (record[0]['values']['dead'] non-empty) raise ProofNamedRed with message f"PROVEME crossing refused for ticket {ticket!r}: proven_by names a proof that resolves to no file — {listing}. Name the proof by its repo-relative path (e.g. skills/sail/proofs/<file>.py); a name since the latest forward BUILDME stays in the union PROVED reads until a forward BUILDME cuts it." — keep the existing message for the empty union; the message must contain 'proven_by' and the ticket id in both. (D) Docstring of inspect_proof_named cites this ticket. PROOF: model on test_proveme_names_its_proof.py — the _PretendCharted context manager (replace transitions._entry_gate and _stamp_sail), _AT_BUILDME = 'bug@v1: THINKME -> TICKETME -> [BUILDME] -> PROVEME -> PROVED', a fixture ticket id no journal carries (assert crossings.proven_by_since_buildme(id) == [] first), tempfile dirs outside any repo (the clean-tree seat records no lane there). Tooth 3: save crossings.ROOTS, set crossings.ROOTS = {'repo': <tmp>/repo, 'commons': <tmp>/commons} (both dirs created), write <tmp>/repo/fx/history.json as {'entries': [{'from': 'TICKETME', 'to': 'BUILDME', 'direction': 'forward', 'ticket': <id>, 'proven_by': 'p/gone.py', 'at': '2026-01-01T10:00:00', 'seq': 1}]}, call crossings._CACHE.clear(), emit; restore ROOTS and clear _CACHE in finally. Main via the same if __name__ == '__main__' runner the sibling uses.

decisions.text: D1: the proof ALREADY LANDED in cairn commit fd95c7fb (red proof): cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_dead_proof_name_is_refused_at_proveme.py carries PROVES['c01503edd010'] with keys '1'-'3' naming the three teeth of the falsifier, all three measured red against today's code (tooth 1: the bare name crossed ungated; tooth 2: values.dead absent; tooth 3: the since-BUILDME dead name crossed). It builds as written — the build edits NO proof file, only cairn/tools/base/transitions.py (D2-D5).

D2: transitions.py gains def _dead_names(named: list[str], since: list[str]) -> list[dict], placed directly above def inspect_proof_named: walk named (origin 'this crossing') then since (origin 'since BUILDME'), skipping a name already seen so a name on both reads 'this crossing'; for each, p = Path(name) if Path(name).is_absolute() else _REPO_ROOT / name; if not p.is_file(), append {'name': name, 'from': origin}; return the list in that order. _REPO_ROOT is the module's existing constant (transitions.py:131); Path is already imported. This is the resolution proof_coverage.lacks makes at PROVED (cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py:350), copied, not imported (RULE 1).

D3: in inspect_proof_named, after union is built: dead = _dead_names(named, list(since)). actual = shown when union and not dead; the EXISTING no-proof text when not union (unchanged); when dead: f"the PROVEME crossing of ticket {ticket!r} names {len(dead)} proof(s) that resolve to no file: " + '; '.join(f"{d['name']!r} ({d['from']})" for d in dead) + " — a name is read repo-relative under the cairn root, or absolute, as proof_coverage reads it at PROVED, which would refuse it as [proof_on_disk]". The _lane call gains dead=dead beside named= and since_buildme=, so values carries 'dead' (an empty list when clean). Identity the_proveme_crossing_names_its_proof, expected (shown), and code string stay; the seat still returns exactly ONE lane (test_proveme_names_its_proof.py:120 asserts it). The docstring gains one paragraph citing c01503edd010: the names must also resolve to files, read the way PROVED reads them.

D4: _proof_named_gate keeps its existing raise for the empty union, and gains a branch BEFORE it: dead = record[0]['values'].get('dead') or []; if bad and dead: raise ProofNamedRed(f"PROVEME crossing refused for ticket {ticket!r}: proven_by names a proof that resolves to no file — " + '; '.join(f"{d['name']!r} ({d['from']})" for d in dead) + ". Name the proof by its repo-relative path (e.g. skills/sail/proofs/<file>.py) or its absolute path; a name on a crossing since the latest forward BUILDME stays in the union PROVED reads until a forward BUILDME cuts it.", findings=_findings_of(record)). Both messages contain 'proven_by' and the ticket id. The clean return ('clean — proof named: ...') is unchanged.

D5: after the build, run through bin/cairn test --exec (pytest is refused): the new proof (3/3 green), then the neighbours unchanged and green — cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_names_its_proof.py, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_entry_needs_a_clean_tree.py, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_transitions.py, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_clearance.py. Seal the new proof with bin/cairn test --netns --seal. The hollow reverts cairn/tools/base/transitions.py to the pre-build commit; all three teeth red there (measured at fd95c7fb).

D6 (settles pass-1 gaps on D2/D3 — builder_notes (A)/(B) and D2 disagreed): the signature is D2's, with NO ticket parameter: def _dead_names(named: list[str], since: list[str]) -> list[dict], called in inspect_proof_named as dead = _dead_names(named, list(since)). The ticket is used only in the lane's actual text, which inspect_proof_named already has in scope. Where builder_notes (A) and (B) show a ticket argument, D2/D3/D6 govern.

D7 (settles pass-1 gap on D4): bad is the EXISTING local in _proof_named_gate — bad = _mismatches(record), the line right after record = inspect_proof_named(ticket, journal_extra) (cairn/tools/base/transitions.py:1438); it is the list of lanes whose expected != actual. _findings_of is the EXISTING helper at transitions.py:321, already used by the current raise. So D4's new branch is: dead = record[0]['values'].get('dead') or []; if bad and dead: raise ProofNamedRed(<D4 message>, findings=_findings_of(record)); and it sits between bad = _mismatches(record) and the existing if bad: raise.
